required_path: Resolve the first beat branch using two observations, propagate the density change at fixed tension, resolve a second beat branch from its trend, and invert the second-harmonic length relation.
separate_method: Exact-rational beat-branch enumeration and harmonic geometry.
qualification: Editorial reasoning-depth judgement; not empirical difficulty calibration.

required_path: Link two measured curvatures by retarding work, infer or eliminate the charge-to-mass ratio, and impose the strip tangency condition to obtain the additional energy loss. A ratio solution still requires all three magnetic geometries and the calibration potential.
separate_method: Ratio of work-energy equations eliminates unknown speed and charge-to-mass ratio; then check absolute energies.
qualification: Editorial reasoning-depth judgement; not empirical difficulty calibration.

required_path: Infer both coil parameters, determine a heat-triggered switching current using dissipation sharing, and solve the reversed-source transient with current continuity and a signed target.
separate_method: Numerical integration to the heat-trigger time, then root of the signed transient.
qualification: Editorial reasoning-depth judgement; not empirical difficulty calibration.

required_path: Combine two integer-order interference conditions, include the plate phase shift, determine the overlap of wavelength-dependent diffraction envelopes, and count only strictly interior positions.
separate_method: Enumerate both integer-order equations and check each point against both open envelopes.
qualification: Editorial reasoning-depth judgement; not empirical difficulty calibration.

required_path: Infer resistance and clamp voltage from distinct diode states, establish the switching threshold, and integrate only the conducting portion of both source ramps.
separate_method: Infer parameters from DC tests and integrate the positive diode current in time.
qualification: Editorial reasoning-depth judgement; not empirical difficulty calibration.

required_path: Use three bridge configurations to isolate the stretched-wire resistance, connect resistance change to constant-volume deformation, and apply the gauge zero correction before converting the length ratio into diameter.
separate_method: Three balance equations and direct resistance-diameter relation at fixed volume.
qualification: Editorial reasoning-depth judgement; not empirical difficulty calibration.
